slides.say: For every number x, diamond of x is equal to x squared minus two x. Diamond of x plus one is equal to what?

slides: This time the input is not a number. It's a whole expression, x plus one. [short pause] We'll solve it two ways, with algebra, and then by plugging in numbers.

slides.say: [short pause] Remember, whatever goes in takes the place of x, and an expression goes in brackets. So we write the same template, with the whole x plus one, in brackets, in both spots. Diamond of x plus one is the bracket x plus one, squared, minus two times the bracket x plus one.
at: whatever goes in takes the place
with the whole x plus one

slides.say: Now open the brackets. The bracket x plus one, squared, is x squared plus two x plus one. And minus two times the bracket x plus one is minus two x minus two. Careful, the minus goes to both parts inside the brackets.
Now collect. Two x minus two x is zero, so the x terms cancel. One minus two is negative one. So we get x squared minus one, and choice number two is our answer.
at: choice number two is our answer

slides.say: [pause] Now let's try plugging in numbers. There are letters in the choices, so I can pick a value for x and compare. The easiest value is x is zero. Then the input is zero plus one, which is one. Diamond of one is one squared minus two times one, so one minus two, which is negative one.

Now the choices with x is zero. Choice number one gives one. Choice number two gives negative one. Choice number three gives negative one too. And choice number four gives three. So choice numbers one and four are out.

Zero was an easy first test, and it already ruled out two choices. But the two choices that are left both give negative one at zero, so zero can't tell them apart. So we try the next easy value, x is two. Then the input is three. Diamond of three is nine minus six, which is three.

Choice number two gives four minus one, which is three. Choice number three gives four minus four minus one, which is negative one. So choice number three is out, and choice number two is our answer. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
at: So choice number three is out
and choice number two is our answer
